subject: planner: Add a framework for disabling the plan cache during optimization. (#65896)
summary: Reviewed the diff vs first parent: adds `NoncacheableReason` plumbing from `util.AccessPath` into plan nodes (`Set/GetNoncacheableReason`) and makes `isPhysicalPlanCacheable` short-circuit on it. Verified partial-index plan-cache safety is preserved and broadened (notably propagating non-cacheability into PointGet/BatchPointGet and MV-index/index-merge-derived paths) without changing query semantics; no remaining Blocker/High issues found.
